name: audit2e zlib crc32 options constants and node:buffer atob btoa Blob
source: import * as zlib from "node:zlib"; import { Blob, atob, btoa } from "node:buffer"; async function main(): Promise<void> { const s = Buffer.from("hello hello hello hello"); console.log(zlib.crc32("abc"), zlib.crc32("def", zlib.crc32("abc")), zlib.crc32(Buffer.from("abcdef"))); console.log(zlib.constants.Z_BEST_COMPRESSION, zlib.constants.Z_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION, zlib.deflateSync(s, { level: 0 }).length, zlib.inflateSync(zlib.deflateSync(s, { level: 9 })).toString()); console.log(zlib.gunzipSync(zlib.gzipSync(s, { level: 1 })).toString(), zlib.inflateRawSync(zlib.deflateRawSync(s, { level: 6 })).toString()); console.log(btoa("hello"), atob("aGVsbG8=")); const b = new Blob(["hello ", "world"]); console.log(b.size, await b.text()); }
